patch.value: GH-1627: bound the entire next response and compact optional TOON sections losslessly

https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/1627

Reported behavior on published2026.10.28; current-source reproduction and implementation are pending. Preserve the completed predecessor scope when evaluating this report.

Found while orienting an agent session with pm 2026.10.28 on a real tracker (~400 items, 95 ready).

Severity: medium (paid on every `pm next`, the first command an agent runs to pick work).

`pm next --limit 5` (TOON, default) prints **6,847 bytes / 72 lines** while its own `filters.token_budget` says **640**. `--token-budget` is documented as bounding only "the ranked ready" rows; every other section is unbudgeted and the total cost is never reported. Measured bytes by section:

| Section | Bytes |
| --- | ---: |
| `blocked[5]` | 1,821 |
| `containers[5]` | 1,469 |
| `ready[5]` (the budgeted part) | 1,331 |
| `decision_needed[3]` | 947 |
| `recommended` | 397 |
| `summary` + `filters` + `held_by_others` + four `*_encoding` blocks | ~780 |

Three avoidable costs inside that:

1. **Side sections ignore the budget and the include flags.** `filters` reports `include_decisions: false` and `include_containers: false`, yet `decision_needed[3]` and `containers[5]` are printed in full (15–18 columns each). Agents read the false flags and the printed sections as a contradiction.
2. **Escaped tag JSON in TOON rows.** 162 `\"` sequences, e.g. `"[\"hosted\",\"tests\",\"website\"]"`, plus a `json_columns` `*_encoding` block per section. #1603 removed this from `pm context`; `pm next` still has it.
3. **All-null columns.** 63 `,null` cells (`order`, `deadline`, `assignee`, `parent` are null in almost every row) across the four tables.

Expected (same contract #1401 gave `pm context`): one budget covers the whole response, or the response reports its own total `estimated_tokens` with a per-section breakdown. Side sections collapse to counts plus ids unless explicitly requested (`--include-decisions` / `--include-containers` / `--blocked-limit`). Tags render as TOON arrays, and columns that are null in every row are omitted with an absent-columns receipt. A contract test that `pm next` output stays within `--token-budget` (± a declared envelope) on a large fixture would keep this from regressing.

Independently measure the reported large ready-work fixture; Account for every response section and total output cost; Honor explicit side-section includes and preserve resumability; Verify lossless tag encoding null-column receipts and JSON/TOON contracts
The complete next response discloses and obeys its effective budget, respects include controls, and preserves tags/null omission receipts without changing full SDK data.
